nodes.label: Public built-in Schema Things
nodes.rationale: Built-in and user-defined schemas share one grammar, while copying visible schemas gives users independent owned definitions without granting protected-kind writes or record contents.

nodes.label: Anonymous draft preview
nodes.rationale: The preview provides offline rendering without an account runtime or storage, leaving existing account-draft and import permissions unchanged.

nodes.label: Backup Execution Path and Deployment Readiness
nodes.rationale: No public admission or UI entry is enabled until the full supported execution path and deployment readiness are independently accepted.

nodes.label: iOS Photos Capture
nodes.rationale: Uses a dedicated reader and a gap ledger to capture available originals while preserving explicit records of inaccessible iCloud-only resources.

nodes.label: File Access 1.6.0
nodes.rationale: Keeps iCloud-only resources explicitly incomplete while transferring available originals.

nodes.label: File Access 1.7.0
nodes.rationale: Fetches an exact iCloud original only with saved explicit cellular allowance and live power/device checks.

nodes.label: File Access 1.8.0
nodes.rationale: Uses PhotoBackupQueue to process asset groups in one date-ordered queue.

nodes.label: Rust Indexer
nodes.rationale: Seals selected originals and exact iCloud gaps; untouched assets require no synthetic gap rows.

nodes.label: pagedForegroundSync
nodes.rationale: After the initial checkpoint, reads only scoped paths needed for the next batch and merges verified pairs into the existing baseline.

nodes.label: Native Batch Acknowledgement
nodes.rationale: Checks exact cloud original fingerprints.

nodes.label: Native Upload 1.5.0
nodes.rationale: Negotiates origin-scoped transfer admission and queues a bounded set of already planned originals in NativeDeferredUpload.

nodes.label: Canonical Cloud Folder and Timeline Publication
nodes.rationale: pagedForegroundSync retains responsibility for canonical cloud folder and Timeline publication.

nodes.label: iOS Photos Settings Recovery
nodes.rationale: Explicit Start/Retry recovers changed settings for the same authorized grant and device while retaining cloud copies, using revision, grant, destination, queue, and live configuration checks before archiving old pointers and admitting a fresh epoch.

nodes.label: Photos Settings Recovery Journal Formats
nodes.rationale: Both journal formats and the signed upload path require verification; an earlier journal and published revision remain available if an unguarded publication is in flight.

nodes.label: Photos Installed Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Acceptance covers ordinary consent, same-grant original hashes and reopen, with storage-readiness gates and assertions that tests actually executed.

nodes.label: nativeDeviceSyncGovernor
nodes.rationale: Allows legacy connections without saved limits on unsupported iOS while refusing explicit device and connection limits.

nodes.label: Mac Resource-Limit Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Mac enforcement remains unchanged.

nodes.label: File Sync Manual Start Preflight
nodes.rationale: Shared by native-host and remote controls, it rereads the exact reviewed owned revision, rejects retained selected drafts and identity changes, compare-and-swap patches only paused=false, requires acknowledgement and matching fresh readback, and returns confirmed configuration for existing runner admission. Uncertain writes never start or blindly retry; save/open and automatic scheduling do not unpause connections.

nodes.label: DeviceSyncResources
nodes.rationale: Together with connection limit controls, classifies the selected iOS bridge capability.

nodes.label: iOS Bridge Capability Classification
nodes.rationale: A locally paired match is verified through its native identity; other devices use scoped status. Missing native resource support displays iOS-managed or unavailable rather than Mac budgets or invented zero telemetry; saved limits/drafts remain intact and ordinary connection progress is separate from native CPU/scan telemetry.

nodes.label: Paused-Start Browser Harness
nodes.rationale: Exercises unsupported iOS capabilities and retained controls at both widths.
